Clear, Texas-based pricing

Notarial fees below reflect the current maximum fees listed by the Texas Secretary of State. Travel/convenience charges are shown separately.

Notarial ActFee
First signature — acknowledgment/proof of deed or other instrument$10
Each additional signature on the same instrument$1
Oath or affirmation with certificate & seal$10
Other notarial acts not otherwise provided for$10
Certified copy of a record/paper in the notary's office, per page$1

Mobile Convenience / Travel

+$25

Travel within a 15-mile radius.

+$35

Travel within a 20-mile radius.

Travel/convenience fees are separate from the notarial act fee. Appointments beyond 20 miles can be quoted by request.

Texas law establishes maximum fees for official notarial acts. Fees should be disclosed and itemized. Travel/convenience pricing should be presented separately from the statutory notarial fee.
